notes: Route by Yu'la: Ibn Jurayj hears Yu'la and Amr (co-transmitters) who both hear Sa'id; Sa'id names Ibn Abbas, who names Ubayy: one saying, one group
Amr's own wording is written only up to Sa'id; the Ibn Abbas to Ubayy links appear in Yu'la's line, so they are kept on the one group
«داود بن أبي عاصم ... عن غير واحد إنها جارية» names a different transmitter for a variant wording: a variant group, never a route (rule 4)

Left out as scene or wording: Nawf and the Kufa exchange, «إنا لعند ابن عباس» (place), «قال لي عثمان بن أبي سليمان» and «قال لي عمرو هكذا» (wording), «يزعمون عن غير سعيد» (unnamed, no chain), the commentary of Sa'id and Ibn Abbas
